αἰδὼς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve; fem. nom. sg.
βάλετ: βάλλω — throw; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (βάλετ’ = βάλετο); in tmesis περὶ … βάλετ’ ’threw around (oneself)’ · also with ἐπί governing the dative: ’threw upon (his shoulders)’ (ἐπὶ στιβαροῖς βάλετ’ ὤμοις)
δάμνησι: δάμνημι — overpower, subdue, tame; pres. 3 sg., epic ending -ησι
δέδυκεν: δύω — sink, plunge, enter; perf. 3 sg. intrans., ν-movable (= δέδυκε): ’has sunk, is sunk’
δίφρος: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. nom. sg.
δαίνυσθαί: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι, feast, banquet; pres. inf. mid.
δεινήν: δεινός — dread, terrible; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Χάρυβδιν
δεινοῖο: δεινός — dread, terrible; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
εἴωθε: ἔωθα (εἴωθα) — be accustomed, be wont; perf. 3 sg. with present sense: ’is accustomed’, + inf.
ζῆν: Ζεύς — Zeus; acc. sg. Ζῆν (elided Ζῆν’ = Ζῆνα), after μά in an oath
θαῦμα: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’a wonder to see’
καδμείων: Καδμεῖοι — Cadmeans, the Thebans; masc. gen. pl., with ἤνασσε
καρτερὸν: καρτερός — strong, mighty, staunch; masc. acc. sg. (καρτερὸν ὅρκον ’a mighty oath’)
κοτέσσεται: κοτέομαι — bear a grudge, be angry; aor. subj. 3 sg., short-vowel: ’is angered’
μάστιγι: μάστιξ — whip, lash; fem. dat. sg., instrumental
μαχητής: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. nom. sg.
μεσσηγὺς: μεσσηγύς — between, in the midst; adv./prep. + gen.
μικρὸς: μικρός — small, little; adj., masc. nom. sg.
νέμεσθαι: νέμομαι — graze, pasture, feed; pres. inf. mid.
οἷσίν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc./neut. dat. pl., accented before an enclitic (οἷσίν τε ’with which’, epic τε) · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.
οὐρανοῦ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. gen. sg.
οὐρανὸς: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
πέπλον: πέπλος — robe, woman’s garment; masc. acc. sg.
πελώρου: πέλωρος — monstrous, huge; as noun πέλωρον ’monster’; neut. gen. sg.
πεπληγυῖα: πλήσσω — strike; perf. act. part. fem. nom. sg., with aorist sense: ’having struck’
ποιήσατο: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’made for himself’
ποικίλον: ποικίλος — inlaid, elaborately wrought, dappled; masc. acc. sg.
πουλὺν: πολύς — much, vast (epic πουλύς); masc. acc. sg., fixed phrase πουλὺν ἐφ’ ὑγρήν ’over the vast deep’ (ὑγρή substantival, ’the sea’)
πρέσβα: πρέσβα (poet. fem. of πρέσβυς) — eldest, first in rank; august, revered (a title of honour, as of goddesses); fem. nom./voc. sg.; with partitive gen. ’eldest of’
σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
στήσασα: ἵστημι — set, make stand, bring to a stop; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having stopped’
τέρπονται: τέρπω — delight, gladden; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’take delight, enjoy themselves’
τελαμῶνα: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. acc. sg.
τελαμῶνος: Τελαμών — Telamon, father of Ajax; masc. gen. sg.
τῇς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic τῇς (= Attic ταῖς): ’to/among them’ · also relative, ’on which’ (τῇς ἔπι … εὗδε ’on which he slept’)
φυλάσσω: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; pres. subj. 1 sg., + acc. of duration: ’keep watch through (the night)’ · also pres. indic. 1 sg.: ’I guard’ (σῦς τάσδε φυλάσσω ’I guard these swine’)
χιτῶν: χιτών — tunic; masc. acc. sg., elided (χιτῶν’ = χιτῶνα)
χρυσέη: χρύσεος — golden; fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῆ)
χρυσείην: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; fem. acc. sg.
χρύσειον: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -ειον (= Attic -οῦν)
ἀλαπαδνόν: ἀλαπαδνός — feeble, weak; neut. nom. sg., with σθένος
ἀμφίς: ἀμφίς — on both sides, around; adv., or postpositive prep. + acc.: ’round about’
ἀμφοτέρωθεν: ἀμφότερος — both; adv. with suffix -θεν: ’on both sides’
ἀνακλῖναι: ἀνακλίνω — lean back, lay back; of the ambush λόχον, ’open’ (inferred); aor. inf. act.
ἀπώλεσε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.
ἀραρυῖαν: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, fit; perf. part. act. fem. acc. sg.: ’fitted (with)’
ἀργύρεος: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀστερόεντος: ἀστερόεις — starry, star-spangled; masc. gen. sg.
ἄγρει: ἄγρει — come now! up!; epic interjection with an imper. sense (perhaps from ἀγρέω ’take’)
ἄκρῳ: ἄκρος — topmost, at the tip; masc./neut. dat. sg. (ἐπ’ ἄκρῳ ’at the tip’)
ἄνωγον: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); past (impf. or plpf.) 3 pl. or 1 sg., unaugmented (augmented ἤνωγον): ’they bade, I bade’
ἄφρονα: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. acc. sg.
ἐλέγχεα: ἔλεγχος — reproach, disgrace; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic (Attic masc. ἔλεγχοι): ’reproaches’
ἐξείρετο: ἐξείρομαι — ask out, inquire into (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented
ἐπιθεῖναι: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, put to; with λόχον, ’shut’ (inferred from the pair with ἀνακλῖναι); aor. inf. act.
ἐπιτάρροθος: ἐπιτάρροθος — helper, ally (formation obscure); masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj. used as noun)
ἐποιχομένη: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at, ply; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (ἱστὸν ἐποιχομένη ’plying the loom’) · also ’go at, come upon, assail’ (βελέεσσιν ἐποιχομένη ’coming upon him with her shafts’) · also ’go after, seek out’ (πόσιν ἐποιχομένη ’going after a husband’)
ἐστεφάνωται: στεφανόω — wreathe, encircle (στέφανος ’crown’); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wreathed round’
ἑκὰς: ἑκάς — far, far off; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’far from’ (νηῶν ἑκὰς ’far from the ships’)
ἔκγονός: ἔκγονος — offspring, descendant; masc. nom. sg.
ἔχευε: χέω — pour; impf. 3 sg., augmented (contrast unaugmented χεῦεν/χεῦον of the same verb)
ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
ἕκηλον: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed, in peace; masc. acc. sg.
ἠέρα: ἀήρ — mist, thick air; masc. acc. sg., epic ἠέρα (= Attic ἀέρα)
ἥμενος: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’)
ἴσχων: ἴσχω — hold, hold back; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
ὀβριμοπάτρη: ὀβριμοπάτρη — epithet of Athena alone: ’of the mighty father’ (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. nom. sg.
ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.
